says: A new chain. Without of, the record is a root and starts a thing named by its own id.
Replaces x inside the thing both are of. Leave out of and it is refused, of-missing. Name a record of another thing and it is refused, prev-unrelated.
Naming every head leaves one head, unless another concurrent head remains.
Any kind may erase. x keeps its id, its signature and its place. Only its payload goes (the protocol calls it the opening).
Nobody's verb: a state. The thing has two heads, both shown, and the newer by content order is listed first.
Not a write at all: a view. The envelope still answers every test on it.
